title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Overdue and Lost Equipment Rules
content:
Unreturned Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment moves from on rent to overdue, and from overdue to converted, on the class thresholds of the overdue and lost equipment table.

## Overdue

Equipment not returned within the class's overdue hours after the due-back time plus the class's return grace minutes is marked overdue by the system.

## Conversion

Equipment overdue for the class's conversion days is treated as lost: the agreement is converted, rental time is billed up to the conversion date, the replacement value on the agreement is billed as a lost equipment charge and the class's lost equipment administrative fee is billed, with any held deposit applied.

## Return after conversion

Equipment returned after conversion is checked in, and the lost equipment charges are reversed only by the rental center manager, not by Customer Care.

## Hypothetical timeline (Ridgeline Rental Hand and Power Tools: 59-minute grace, 24 hours, 7 days, 25.00 fee)

| Moment | State |
|---|---|
| Monday 17:00 | due-back time |
| Monday 17:59 | end of the return grace |
| Tuesday 17:59 | 24 hours after the grace ends; still unreturned, so marked overdue |
| 7 days in overdue status | converted: rental time billed to the conversion date, replacement value of, say, 400.00 billed as lost equipment, 25.00 administrative fee billed, held deposit applied |

## Questions answered

- *A converted saw is brought back. Can Customer Care remove the lost equipment charges?* No; only the rental center manager reverses them.
- *Is the time after conversion billed?* Rental time is billed up to the conversion date.
